speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I did not ask for a magic wand that fixes every late feed, I asked for the pipeline to run without a human touching it every night. You cannot automate a process you do not monitor, so give me the alerts and the retry logic before we talk about removing my team from the loop.
output.correction: You filed this as a desire for full autonomy, but I am actually asking for reliable automation with strict governance on failure. I want the system to handle the routine, not to hide when it breaks, so please label this as a need for monitored automation, not blind trust.
